scoring_justification: The checker recomputes the expected ground-state observables (energy, occupation, correlation, squared magnetization) from the lattice structure using the paper's formulas (Eqs. 9a-9d and relation for magnetization squared) with high-resolution numerical integration. Agent's submitted values are compared against these recomputed values with an absolute tolerance of 1e-4.

schema.notes: lattice is a string (linear_chain, square_lattice, simple_cubic); other columns are numeric floats except occupation_number which may be the string 'Inf' for the linear chain.

outputs.description: Reproduced ground-state properties from the linear spin-wave calculation, to be compared against reference values from the paper using a tolerance-based comparison.

output_contract.notes: Scored by result-level comparison against hidden gold values extracted from the paper's Tables I-III, using absolute tolerance 1e-4 for finite quantities; the linear chain occupation number passes automatically if set to 'Inf'.

steps.description: Full set of ground-state observables for three lattices. The checker recomputes gold values and compares each finite quantity; 1D occupation is checked for string 'Inf'; 1D squared magnetization is not scored.
